about.subtitle: Your Specialized Dentist
about.paragraph1: With more than ten years of experience providing exceptional dental care, Dr. Mostafa combines medical precision with a human touch that helps every patient feel comfortable and reassured.
about.paragraph2: He holds a Bachelor's degree in Oral and Dental Surgery from MUST University, with advanced training in zirconia restorations, immediate dental implants, and clear aligners.
about.paragraph3: Dr. Mostafa believes that prevention is better than treatment, which is why he dedicates part of every session to educating patients and explaining how to maintain their dental health in the long term.

services.title: What Do We Offer?
services.description: A comprehensive range of dental services using the latest technologies and high-quality materials to ensure the best results.

cleaning.title: Teeth Cleaning
cleaning.description: Professional deep cleaning that removes plaque and stains while protecting your teeth from cavities and gum disease.

whitening.title: Teeth Whitening
whitening.description: Advanced whitening techniques that give you a brighter smile and limitless confidence.

rootCanal.title: Root Canal Treatment
rootCanal.description: Precise and safe root canal treatment that preserves the natural tooth and helps avoid extraction.

zirconia.title: Zirconia Restorations
zirconia.description: Zirconia crowns and bridges with a precise natural color match and exceptional durability.

orthodontics.title: Orthodontics
orthodontics.description: Clear and traditional braces to correct alignment and achieve proper occlusion.

implants.title: Dental Implants
implants.description: High-quality titanium implants that closely replicate natural teeth in both appearance and function.
